capabilities: Sync vault files through a Dropbox App Folder
Merge concurrent text edits line by line into conflict blocks
Keep unmergeable files as dated conflict copies
Pause a sync that would delete many files
Optionally sync settings, themes, snippets and plugins
extras: Not in the community plugin list; installed by copying release files into the plugin folder. Needs Obsidian 1.11.4 or later. Dropbox is the only provider built; device journals for other providers are design-only. Enabling configuration folder sync copies other plugins' settings, which may hold secrets, to Dropbox.
problem: Keeping a vault the same on several devices through a cloud storage service, without losing concurrent edits or wiping files by accident.

relations.evidence: Seamsync sends the vault's files over the network to your Dropbox
the third-party plugin Mobile Hot Reload serves it from a desktop Obsidian

summary: Plugin that keeps one person's vault identical across desktop and mobile devices by syncing its files through a Dropbox App Folder.
